implemented_branches: Exact test102x10 and train1000x3 support declarations, separately admitted train order, all10subjects17ROIs, no authentic body reads.
Brain split key selection, full axis1 repetition mean, dimNone Pearson-distance expression, per-ROI subject stack, no external mean.
Separate-NPZ complete file/key/shape support, natural filename and first-file layer-key order, explicit tie and extraneous-file refusal.
Literal author PCA100/estimator102 for both splits, per-layer estimator prefix and all-stimulus transform.
Strict threshold and falsy-zero branch, scalar squeeze convention, all native constructor/allocation omissions retained.
Explicit admitted run profiles for PCA/SRP/no reduction; missing historical SRP parameters remain unbound.
Automatic PCA mle or omitted-keyword SRP fit_transform, bound resolved witness, count mutation across later layers, no independent per-layer auto reset.
No-reduction ignores all reduction kwargs; final flatten, Pearson/no-standardization and layer-RDM emission operations are declared, not executed.
Immutable per-model contracts and small canonical summaries for streamed parent composition.

critical_distinctions.current_donor_vs_historical: Pinning held current Net2Brain source does not identify the paper runtime or native constructor defaults. All historical equivalence flags remain false.
critical_distinctions.producer_vs_evaluation_axis: Expected producer axis includes every emitted NPZ key. RSA skips/normalization/evaluation subset are a distinct parent binding; no producer narrowing.
critical_distinctions.source_vs_original_metadata: Coordinates, shapes and admission hashes are caller declarations. Parent must verify captured admission records; canonical equality does not authenticate original payloads.
critical_distinctions.training_vs_model_learning: train is the dataset split label; compiler performs no model training and introduces no training augmentation.

refusal_domains: Wrong test protocol order or unbound train-order admission
Missing/extra producer keys, cross-stimulus shape mismatch/broadcast domain
Estimator rows exceeding file count (source uninitialized rows)
Unbound run-spec or automatic-resolution witness; wrong prefix/model/run/input binding; unused witnesses
Opaque or float canonical values; measured canonical cap before encoding
native_limits: No rank, numerical finiteness, zero-variance, device or native fit-success guarantee
No physical memory/deadline/OS process wrapper or acquisition authority
serialization_rule: Exact ensure_ascii JSON byte count is checked and precharged before encoding; all compiler digests and summary serializations use that path. DEL fix and prior5-byte undercharge are retained in BUILD_RESULTS.
